title: MingCute Screenshot Quality Recovery batch 074
review_goal: Differentiate paint, paper, and pen variants with screenshot grounded depicts and deterministic evidence fields.

items.depicts_observation: Paint bucket outline with one tilted handle and one drip falling at right
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a tilted paint bucket with a single drip falling on the right side.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the paint roller when the main body should be one horizontal roller bar.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot shows a tipped bucket with a droplet hanging from the right side.

items.depicts_observation: Paint roller with one horizontal bar above one lower handle stem
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a paint roller tool with a horizontal roller bar and a lower handle.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the paint bucket when the tool should not tip or drip at the right side.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot replaces the bucket with a roller bar linked to one short lower handle.

items.depicts_observation: Curled paper sheet with two upper text bars and one lower fold block
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a document page with a curled lower corner and text bars above.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the wavy receipt page when both side edges should bend inward and outward.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot keeps a page curl block at the lower edge under the two upper text bars.

items.depicts_observation: Wavy paper sheet with two upper text bars inside curved side edges
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a paper sheet whose side edges wave inward and outward.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the curled paper page when a folded lower corner block should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot bends both side edges of the page and removes the folded corner block.

items.depicts_observation: Fountain pen nib frame with one centered hole and one top cap line
items.context_bias: Use when the interface wants a fountain pen nib shape rather than a full pen body.
items.ambiguity_note: Do not use for the full pen or pencil icons when a long writing body should remain visible.
items.selection_reason: The screenshot focuses on the nib frame with one centered hole and a short cap line above.
